blocks.text: CHICAGO — It’s official: Skydance-owned Paramount closed its $81-billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery on Tuesday, Oct. 6, ushering in a new Hollywood behemoth. The merger brings two of America’s oldest moviemaking studios together under a new name: Skydance. HBO Max, titles ranging from “Harry Potter” to “Sinners” and networks such as CNN now also find themselves under the same roof as Paramount+, CBS and the likes of “Top Gun” and “The Godfather.” All are under the helm of billionaire David Ellison and his new co-CEO Ynon Kreiz. “Today is a historic day, not just for Skydance but for our entire […]...
